Class MessagePackIO.Writer

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.common.serialization.MessagePackIO.Writer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
MessagePackIO
public static final class MessagePackIO.Writer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A reusable heap-array writer. Returned byte arrays are independent snapshots.

    • addPayload

      public MessagePackIO.Writer addPayload(byte[] bytes)
      Appends unframed bytes, retaining large arrays until clear/close. Callers must not mutate the array before taking the output snapshot. This preserves the historical large-payload copy boundary.
